name: Bouncy Castle Provider (FIPS Distribution)
description: The FIPS 140-3 Bouncy Castle Crypto package is a Java implementation of cryptographic algorithms certified to FIPS 140-3 level 1. This jar contains the debug version JCE provider and low-level API for the BC-FJA version 2.0.2, FIPS Certificate #4743. Please note the debug jar is not certified.
